purpose: Standalone freeze-candidate draft only; not an implementation, execution authorization, frozen protocol, or verdict.

scope.classification: nondimensional classical mixed Model-B(psi)/Model-A(Phi) gradient-flow surrogate
excluded_claims: Liouville, CFT, BCJ, consciousness, quantum advantage

model.pdes: partial_t psi=M_psi Delta mu_psi; partial_t Phi=-M_Phi mu_Phi

coercivity.mean_constraint: mean(psi)=0 is preserved by Model-B dynamics
coercivity.bound: After formal minimization over nonzero psi modes, -eta^2/2 <P',L_psi^-1 P'> >= -eta^2/4 ||P'||_2^2 >= -eta^2/4 ||Phi^2||_2^2, where P'=Phi^2-mean(Phi^2), L_psi=-Delta+1, and its smallest nonzero eigenvalue on [0,2pi)^2 is 2.
coercivity.condition: lambda_Phi>eta^2 is sufficient, not necessary, for quartic coercivity.
coercivity.checked: For lambda={0.5,1,2} and |eta|<=0.1, lambda-eta^2 is at least 0.49.
coercivity.limits: Continuum coercivity, numerical boundedness, and the nonphysical catastrophic guard |field|<=1e6 are distinct.

discretization.cadence: record t=0,T and every 0.05; trajectory quadrature is trapezoid with endpoint weight .025, interior weight .05, and spatial weight dx^2

fft.state_band: K_N=N/2-1; retain max(|kx|,|ky|)<=K_N; set kx=-N/2 or ky=-N/2 Nyquist lines to zero
fft.derivative: i*k on retained modes and zero on prohibited Nyquist modes; gradient energy uses the same retained k^2 symbol
fft.reality: complex128 spectra/float64 fields; fhat[-k]=conjugate(fhat[k]); only retained self-conjugate mode is (0,0), real.

padded_products.algorithm: Embed retained N-grid coefficients unchanged at identical physical signed modes in zero 2N spectra; inverse with unscaled 2N inverse; evaluate Phi^2, Phi^3, Phi*psi, Phi*(Phi^2-v_Phi^2), and every coupling product there; forward normalize by (2N)^-2; truncate to retained N dynamic band. No additional scale factor.

diagnostics.truncation_fraction: padded nonlinear spectral energy outside N retained band before restriction / all padded nonlinear spectral energy; <=0.10
diagnostics.near_cutoff_fraction: resolved state energy in .8*K_N<=max(|kx|,|ky|)<=K_N / resolved-state retained energy; <=0.02
diagnostics.refinement: both recorded at N=32/64/128 and non-increasing 64-to-128 outside a 1e-12 floor

rng_and_initial_conditions.seed: seed is reduced modulo 2^64; key=(low32(seed), high32(seed) XOR field_tag).
rng_and_initial_conditions.counter: counter=(zigzag32(kx),zigzag32(ky),component,stream_tag), with zigzag32(k)=uint32(2*k) for k>=0 and uint32(-2*k-1) for k<0; allowed |k|<=4 avoids overflow.
rng_and_initial_conditions.uniform_normal: u=(uint32_value+0.5)/2^32. For each representative mode use Philox output words r0,r1 from component=0: u1=(r0+.5)/2^32,u2=(r1+.5)/2^32; g1=sqrt(-2log u1)cos(2piu2),g2=sqrt(-2log u1)sin(2piu2), z_k=(g1+i*g2)/sqrt(2).
rng_and_initial_conditions.representatives: ky>0 OR (ky==0 AND kx>0). For each 0<sqrt(kx^2+ky^2)<=4, set z_-k=conjugate(z_k). The zero mode is fixed to zero. No other populated self-conjugate mode exists at N>=32.
rng_and_initial_conditions.fields: Generate psi and Phi with their separate field tags, normalize each once from the common continuum modal table by locked Parseval RMS to physical-space RMS .05, retain zero mean, and reuse exact modal coefficients at every grid; higher modes are zero padded, never redrawn.
rng_and_initial_conditions.hashing: SHA-256 canonical ordered signed-mode coefficient table, Philox known-answer manifest, and each C-order float64 array with shape/dtype metadata.

startup_audits: Philox known-answer vectors: seed=0, field_tag=0x50534931, mode=(1,0), component=0, stream=0x494E4954 must be generated by the stated Philox4x32-10 reference and stored with four uint32 words; repeat for Phi tag/mode=(0,1) and phase stream. Any mismatch fails startup.
analytic trigonometric spectral derivative relative L2 <1e-12
variational central finite-difference directional-derivative relative mismatch <1e-6
2N padded-product oracle versus direct modal convolution on fixed sparse trigonometric fields, separately Phi^2, Phi^3, Phi*psi, Phi*(Phi^2-v^2): maximum retained complex128 modal error <1e-12
Oracle A eta=0 exact psi modal decay, L2 and modal-max error <=.02 at finest dt; dt/2-to-dt/4 <=.02

Oracle B forced manufactured coupled solution at lambda=1,v=1,eta=.1,A=.1,B=.1,T_oracle=1: psi_ex=.1e^-t cos(x)cos(y), Phi_ex=.1e^-2t sin(x)sin(y); use partial_t psi=Delta mu_psi+f_psi with f_psi=5psi_ex+eta Delta(Phi_ex^2), and partial_t Phi=-mu_Phi+f_Phi with f_Phi=lambda Phi_ex(Phi_ex^2-v^2)-2eta Phi_ex psi_ex. Forcing is absent from all evaluation arms. Both field trajectory/final norms require 32-to-64<=.15,64-to-128<=.05, finest temporal<=.02.

imex.scheme: simultaneous first-order IMEX, proposed only; convergence must be measured and energy stability is not claimed
imex.old_state: All nonlinear padded products on both RHSs use (psi^n,Phi^n) before either update.
imex.post_step: set psi k=0 to initial coefficient; zero Nyquist lines; symmetrize Hermitian pairs only as roundoff correction; record relative spectral correction and hard-fail if >1e-13.

one_way.label: NONVARIATIONAL_CONTROL
one_way.rule: Phi evolves with eta0 stored psi trajectory; psi is the exact eta0 parent artifact, not evolved again.

phase.rule: phase-randomized psi coefficients, original matched Phi coefficients, full bidirectional dynamics; its H1 endpoints are reported descriptively and are not used as null expectations. H3 compares A_full to A_phase.

sign.rule: mechanistic sensitivity only; cannot pass/fail H1-H4.

seeds.meaning: random initial-condition ensemble, not physical subjects

production_error.rule: If any endpoint error cannot be estimated, its hypothesis is INCONCLUSIVE.

hypotheses.H1: lower paired-bootstrap endpoints of E_psi and E_Phi each exceed their own delta_q
hypotheses.H2: lower paired-bootstrap endpoint of E_feedback_Phi exceeds delta_feedback
hypotheses.H3: lower paired-bootstrap endpoint of A_full-A_phase exceeds delta_A in the predeclared positive direction
hypotheses.H4: one_way psi uses identical eta0 trajectory artifact reference, hash, and condition-parent ID; mismatch is a hard provenance failure, not a bootstrap result.

evaluation.bootstrap: paired complete held-out seed records; 10000 Philox resamples using bootstrap stream 0x42535450 and seed 20260825; persist canonical index manifest hash; recompute ratio endpoints within each replicate; np.quantile(samples,[.025,.975],method='linear'). n=16 cannot increase after outcome access; inadequate precision is INCONCLUSIVE.

validity.convergence: Compare fine fields only after restriction to common band max(|kx|,|ky|)<=N_coarse/2-1. For full psi/Phi trajectories, final fields, E_psi,E_Phi,E_feedback_Phi,A, and free-energy trajectory, relative error divides by max(reference norm,1e-12). Require 32-to-64<=.15,64-to-128<=.05,dt/2-to-dt/4<=.02 and non-increasing refinement above floor.
validity.energy: Variational arms eta0/full/phase/sign only: D_num=sum every accepted dt[M_psi integral|grad mu_psi|^2+M_Phi integral mu_Phi^2]; R_E=abs(F(T)-F(0)+D_num)/max(abs(F(T)-F(0)),D_num,max(1,abs(F(0)),abs(F(T)))). Require median R_E<=1e-3,95th percentile<=1e-2,and non-increasing dt refinement. One_way is NONVARIATIONAL_CONTROL: report fields/convergence but do not apply this law or fail it for nonmonotone F.

artifacts.atomic_write: Write each JSON/checkpoint/receipt to a same-directory unique temporary file, fsync file, atomically replace destination, then fsync directory where supported; never publish a partial final artifact.
artifacts.resume_identity: Resume only when protocol/source/config/environment/condition/initial-modal-table/array/RNG/checkpoint hashes, optimizer-free solver state, accepted-step counter, output cadence state, and terminal-state expectation all match; otherwise hard-fail resume.
per_condition: final fields at fixed output times

verdict_logic.execution_complete: true only when every required condition, replay, diagnostic, bootstrap, and finalizer terminates, whatever the scientific outcome.
verdict_logic.gate_pass: true only when execution_complete, all applicable hard-validity gates, production calibration, H1,H2,H3,H4, and all artifact/hash validations pass.
verdict_logic.earned_if_pass: Only a numerical statement: in this declared nondimensional classical system, environment, and tested arms, the coupling produced finite, convergent, reproducible effects satisfying H1-H4.
verdict_logic.unearned: All excluded scope claims, CP11, and general physical conclusions remain gated.
